title: Supplied-tensorator normalization on bounded flat stages
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with module-sheaf derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $F=L f^*$ be the recorded derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], supplied with a strong monoidal structure for the recorded derived tensors [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and suppose termwise tensor pullback $H=f^*$ is additive [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $q_Y$ for the homotopy quotient, $Q_Y,Q_Z$ for localization, $L=Q_YF$, and $G=H^hQ_Z$. Write $c_X(K):\mathcal O_X[1]\otimes K\cong K[1]$ for the canonical first-variable Koszul comparison followed by the translated left unitor [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso], and $\delta_F$ for the supplied inverse tensorator. For an isomorphism $e:F(\mathcal O_Y[1])\cong\mathcal O_Z[1]$ put $b_e(K)=F(c_Y(K)^{-1});\delta_F(\mathcal O_Y[1],K);(e\otimes\mathrm{id});c_Z(F(K))$. There are $e:F(\mathcal O_Y[1])\cong\mathcal O_Z[1]$ and isomorphisms $\beta_X:L(X)\cong G(X)$ for every $X$ in the bounded-flat shift-representative class $B_Y$ [def-sc-bounded-flat-shift-representative]. For every homotopy map $s:X\to X'$ between such objects, $L(s);\beta_{X'}=\beta_X;G(s)$. For every bounded-above complex $P$ of flat modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], setting $X=q_Y(P)$ gives $\beta_{X[1]};\mathrm{commShift}_G(X)=F(\mathrm{commShift}_{Q_Y}(X));b_e(Q_YX);\beta_X[1]$. No telescope or unbounded model component is asserted.
